title: Opening hours
en: We are open Monday to Saturday from 7:30 to 19:00. On Sundays we open from 10:00 to 14:00 for urgent visits only.
sw: Tunafunguliwa Jumatatu hadi Jumamosi kuanzia saa 7:30 hadi 19:00. Jumapili tunafunguliwa saa 10:00 hadi 14:00 kwa wagonjwa wa dharura pekee.

title: Booking an appointment
en: Book through the form on our website or at the reception desk. You will receive an SMS to confirm your appointment.
sw: Panga miadi kupitia fomu kwenye tovuti yetu au kwenye dawati la mapokezi. Utapokea ujumbe mfupi wa SMS kuthibitisha miadi yako.

title: What to bring
en: Bring your national ID and insurance card. If another facility referred you, bring the referral letter.
sw: Leta kitambulisho cha taifa na kadi ya bima. Ikiwa umetumwa na kituo kingine, leta barua ya rufaa.

title: Dental services
en: Dental services are available on Mondays and Fridays by appointment only.
sw: Huduma za meno zinapatikana Jumatatu na Ijumaa kwa miadi pekee.

title: Payment
en: We accept cash and M-Pesa. Insurance direct billing is not available for dental services.
sw: Tunapokea pesa taslimu na M-Pesa. Bima haitumiki moja kwa moja kwa huduma za meno.

title: Lab results
en: Malaria and blood sugar test results are ready the same day. Other lab results take up to 3 days.
sw: Matokeo ya vipimo vya malaria na sukari huwa tayari siku hiyo hiyo. Matokeo mengine huchukua hadi siku 3.

title: Family planning clinic
en: The family planning clinic runs on Thursdays from 10:00 to 15:00.
sw: Kliniki ya uzazi wa mpango hufanyika Alhamisi kuanzia saa 10:00 hadi 15:00.

title: Access and parking
en: The clinic has a wheelchair ramp and free parking for patients.
sw: Zahanati ina njia ya kuingia kwa viti vya magurudumu na maegesho ya bure kwa wagonjwa.

title: Visitors
en: Each patient may have two visitors, between 16:00 and 18:00.
sw: Kila mgonjwa anaruhusiwa wageni wawili, kati ya saa 16:00 na 18:00.

title: Cancelling or rescheduling
en: Please cancel or reschedule at least 12 hours before your appointment.
sw: Tafadhali ghairi au badilisha miadi yako angalau saa 12 kabla ya wakati wake.
